title: Victory_Road
lead_summary: Victory Road is the last hurdle before players can reach Indigo Plateau. It is a challenging cave with strong trainers and wild Pokémons, and trainers need to push boulders with either HM04 Strength or the Dolly, the HM Replacement Item, on some pressure plates to open passages.
